title: Before → after, phone
caption: Two tabs hid three of five upgrades; now the castle, five tokens, one card, one CTA.

title: Before → after, desk
caption: A narrow column of buttons becomes the castle beside the pick.

title: Each tier's whole castle, parts at mixed levels
caption: Timber, Stone, Fortified, Grand: walls, roofs and gate redraw; every part keeps its level.

title: One part across its levels: the barracks yard
caption: Opening deal 0–5: the fenced plot, a tent, the arms rack, a second tent, a recruit, an archer.

title: The lookout across its levels
caption: Scouts 0–2: timber on the east tower, a lookout, then taller with a roof and a flag.

title: The highlight on tap
caption: Tap an upgrade and its part is ringed in gold while the rest steps back. Clear which part is which?

title: The milestone line
caption: One quiet line names what the next tier needs, e.g. 'Stone castle: raise Scouts to level 1'.

title: The home mark per tier
caption: Log palisade, grey stone, slate with gold banners, white stone with red pennants, redrawn at 16 px.

title: The home bar per tier
caption: The plate beside Crates, Codex and Settings. Same family?

title: Upgrade states: locked, buyable, can't afford, maxed
caption: Padlock and count; price; price in red and 'Need 60 more'; gold pips and 'Max'.

title: The tier's rise
caption: Once per new tier, the next time the HQ opens: the old castle fades off and the new name shows for a beat. Off under reduced motion.

title: A 320 phone
caption: The castle runs edge to edge so every part fits; the card is a scroll below.

title: Desk layout
caption: The castle on the left, the pick on the right, the CTA under the pick.
